lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਜਾਇਦਾ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: aap tarai sagale kul taare har daragah pat siu jaaidaa ||6||
lines.translation: You shall save yourself, and save all your generations as well. You shall go to the Court of the Lord with honor. ||6||
All the continents, nether worlds, islands and worlds

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kaalai vas aap prabh keeaa ||
lines.translation: God Himself has made them all subject to death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਜੋ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: nihachal ek aap abinaasee so nihachal jo tisahi dhiaaidaa ||7||
lines.translation: The One Imperishable Lord Himself is unmoving and unchanging. Meditating on Him, one becomes unchanging. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kaa sevak so har jehaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord's servant becomes like the Lord.
Do not think that, because of his human body, he is different.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਤਰੰਗ ਉਠਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਸਲਲੈ ਸਲਲ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: jiu jal tara(n)g uthahi bahu bhaatee phir salalai salal samaaidaa ||8||
lines.translation: The waves of the water rise up in various ways, and then the water merges again in water. ||8||
A beggar begs for charity at His Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa prabh bhaavai taa kirapaa dhaarai ||
lines.translation: When God pleases, He takes pity on him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਹੁ ਦਰਸੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਠਹਰਾਇਦਾ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: dehu daras jit man tripataasai har keeratan man thaharaaidaa ||9||
lines.translation: Please bless me with the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan, to satisfy my mind, O Lord. Through the Kirtan of Your Praises, my mind is held steady. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੂੜੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਕਿਤੈ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: rooRo thaakur kitai vas na aavai ||
lines.translation: The Beauteous Lord and Master is not controlled in any way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਸੰਤਾ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har so kichh kare j har kiaa sa(n)taa bhaavai ||
lines.translation: The Lord does that which pleases the Saints of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੀਤਾ ਲੋੜਨਿ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਾਇਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਫੇਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: keetaa loRan soee karaain dar pher na koee paaidaa ||10||
lines.translation: He does whatever they wish to be done; nothing blocks their way at His Door. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਅਉਘਟੁ ਆਇ ਬਨਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jithai aughat aai banat hai praanee ||
lines.translation: Wherever the mortal is confronted with difficulty,
there he should meditate on the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੁ ਕਲਤ੍ਰੁ ਨ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋਈ ਤਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: jithai putr kalatr na belee koee tithai har aap chhadaaidaa ||11||
lines.translation: Where there are no children, spouse or friends, there the Lord Himself comes to the rescue. ||11||
The Great Lord and Master is inaccessible and unfathomable.
How can anyone meet with God, the self-suficient One?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਸੋ ਵਿਚਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaat silak jis maarag paae so vich sa(n)gat vaasaa paaidaa ||12||
lines.translation: Those who have had the noose cut away from around their necks, whom God has set back upon the Path, obtain a place in the Sangat, the Congregation. ||12||
One who realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command is said to be His servant.
He endures both bad and good equally.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ਤ ਏਕੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: haumai jaai ta eko boojhai so guramukh sahaj samaaidaa ||13||
lines.translation: When egotism is silenced, then one comes to know the One Lord. Such a Gurmukh intuitively merges in the Lord. ||13||
The devotees of the Lord dwell forever in peace.
With a child-like, innocent nature, they remain detached, turning away from the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਜਿਉ ਪਿਤਾ ਪੂਤੁ ਲਾਡਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: anik ra(n)g karahi bahu bhaatee jiu pitaa poot laadaaidaa ||14||
lines.translation: They enjoy various pleasures in many ways; God caresses them, like a father caressing his son. ||14||
He is inaccessible and unfathomable; His value cannot be estimated.
We meet Him, only when He causes us to meet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh pragat bhaiaa tin jan kau jin dhur masatak lekh likhaaidaa ||15||
lines.translation: The Lord is revealed to those humble Gurmukhs, who have such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon their foreheads. ||15||
You Yourself are the Creator Lord, the Cause of causes.
You created the Universe, and You support the whole earth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਇਦਾ ॥੧੬॥੧॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak saran paiaa har duaarai har bhaavai laaj rakhaaidaa ||16||1||5||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of Your Door, O Lord; if it is Your Will, please preserve his honor. ||16||1||5||
Maaroo, Solahas, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Whatever is seen is You, O One Lord.
What the ears hear is the Word of Your Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੀ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਪਸਿ ਕਾਈ ਸਗਲ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਧਾਰਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: doojee avar na jaapas kaaee sagal tumaaree dhaaranaa ||1||
lines.translation: There is nothing else to be seen at all. You give support to all. ||1||
You Yourself are conscious of Your Creation.
You Yourself established Yourself, O God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ਰਚਿਓਨੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਆਪੇ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਸਾਰਣਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aap upaai rachion pasaaraa aape ghat ghat saaranaa ||2||
lines.translation: Creating Yourself, You formed the expanse of the Universe; You Yourself cherish and sustain each and every heart. ||2||
You created some to hold great and royal courts.
Some turn away from the world in renunciation, and some maintain their households.
